correctness.rationale: For m>=3, same-column distinct picks share a third neighbor; selected columns encode 0 or one row label. Length-two common-neighbor walks force adjacent occupied labels equal and distance-two occupied labels unequal, an exact four-memory-state transfer. Its formal inverse supplies the rational bivariate generating function. The no-111 condition gives k=ceil(2n/3); classifying the 3q,3q+1,3q+2 run/gap patterns proves all maximum-count formulas including n=1,2,3. Independently built literal graph neighborhoods and exhaustively compared all subsets with the four-state enumerator for six small labeled graphs (m,n)=(3,1..5),(4,3). Those finite results corroborate, not prove, the symbolic all-parameter identity.
